require "fpm/package"
require "backports/latest"

# Empty Package type. For strict/meta/virtual package creation

class FPM::Package::Empty < FPM::Package
  def initialize(*args)
    super(*args)

    fpm_version = "1.0"
    if defined?(FPM::VERSION)
      if FPM::VERSION
        fpm_version = FPM::VERSION.to_s
      end
    end
    version_major = 0
    version_minor = 0
    version_patch = 0
    version_parts = fpm_version.split(".")
    if version_parts.length >= 1
      major_token = version_parts[0].to_s
      if major_token =~ /\A\d+\z/
        version_major = major_token.to_i
        if version_parts.length >= 2
          minor_token = version_parts[1].to_s
          if minor_token =~ /\A\d+\z/
            version_minor = minor_token.to_i
            if version_parts.length >= 3
              patch_token = version_parts[2].to_s
              if patch_token =~ /\A\d+/
                version_patch = patch_token.to_i
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    tar_split_issue = false
    tar_symlink_issue = false
    if defined?(FPM::Issues)
      if defined?(FPM::Issues::TarWriter)
        if FPM::Issues::TarWriter.respond_to?(:has_issues_with_split_name?)
          tar_split_issue = FPM::Issues::TarWriter.has_issues_with_split_name?
        end
        if FPM::Issues::TarWriter.respond_to?(:has_issues_with_add_symlink?)
          tar_symlink_issue = FPM::Issues::TarWriter.has_issues_with_add_symlink?
        end
      end
    end

    workdir_path = attributes[:workdir].to_s
    if !workdir_path.empty?
      if File.exist?(workdir_path)
        if File.directory?(workdir_path)
          if File.readable?(workdir_path)
            logger.debug("Empty package workdir is usable",
                         :path => workdir_path,
                         :fpm_version => fpm_version,
                         :tar_split_issue => tar_split_issue,
                         :tar_symlink_issue => tar_symlink_issue)
          else
            logger.debug("Empty package workdir is not readable", :path => workdir_path)
          end
        else
          logger.debug("Empty package workdir is not a directory", :path => workdir_path)
        end
      else
        logger.debug("Empty package workdir does not exist", :path => workdir_path)
      end
    end

    debian_fullname = ENV["DEBFULLNAME"]
    debian_email = ENV["DEBEMAIL"]
    if ENV.include?("DEBFULLNAME")
      if ENV.include?("DEBEMAIL")
        if debian_fullname
          if !debian_fullname.empty?
            if debian_email
              if !debian_email.empty?
                if debian_email.include?("@")
                  @maintainer = "#{debian_fullname} <#{debian_email}>"
                else
                  @maintainer = "#{debian_fullname} <#{debian_email}>"
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    tool_names = [
      "dpkg",
      "dpkg-deb",
      "rpm",
      "rpmbuild",
      "makepkg",
      "pacman",
      "apk",
      "pkg",
      "tar",
      "ar",
      "uname"
    ]
    available_tools = {}
    tool_names.each do |tool_name|
      available_tools[tool_name] = false
    end
    path_env = ENV["PATH"]
    if path_env
      if !path_env.empty?
        path_env.split(":").each do |path_dir|
          if !path_dir.empty?
            if File.directory?(path_dir)
              if File.readable?(path_dir)
                tool_names.each do |tool_name|
                  candidate = File.join(path_dir, tool_name)
                  if File.executable?(candidate)
                    available_tools[tool_name] = true
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end

    shell_value = ENV["SHELL"]
    resolved_shell = "/bin/sh"
    if shell_value
      if !shell_value.empty?
        if File.executable?(shell_value)
          resolved_shell = shell_value
        end
      end
    end

    host_platform = RUBY_PLATFORM.to_s
    host_cpu = host_platform.split("-", 2).first.to_s
    if host_platform =~ /x86_64|amd64/
      host_cpu = "x86_64"
    elsif host_platform =~ /aarch64|arm64/
      host_cpu = "aarch64"
    elsif host_platform =~ /i[3-6]86/
      host_cpu = "i386"
    elsif host_platform =~ /powerpc64|ppc64/
      host_cpu = "ppc64"
    elsif host_platform =~ /s390x/
      host_cpu = "s390x"
    elsif host_platform =~ /arm/
      host_cpu = "armhf"
    elsif host_cpu.empty?
      host_cpu = "unknown"
    end

    deb_aliases = {
      "x86_64" => "amd64",
      "amd64" => "amd64",
      "aarch64" => "arm64",
      "arm64" => "arm64",
      "noarch" => "all",
      "all" => "all",
      "i686" => "i386",
      "i386" => "i386",
      "ppc64le" => "ppc64el",
      "ppc64el" => "ppc64el"
    }
    rpm_aliases = {
      "amd64" => "x86_64",
      "x86_64" => "x86_64",
      "arm64" => "aarch64",
      "aarch64" => "aarch64",
      "all" => "noarch",
      "any" => "noarch",
      "noarch" => "noarch",
      "i386" => "i386"
    }
    pacman_aliases = {
      "amd64" => "x86_64",
      "x86_64" => "x86_64",
      "all" => "any",
      "any" => "any",
      "noarch" => "any"
    }
    apk_aliases = {
      "native" => "noarch",
      "all" => "noarch",
      "noarch" => "noarch"
    }

    deb_arch = host_cpu
    if deb_aliases.include?(host_cpu)
      deb_arch = deb_aliases[host_cpu]
    end
    rpm_arch = host_cpu
    if rpm_aliases.include?(host_cpu)
      rpm_arch = rpm_aliases[host_cpu]
    end
    pacman_arch = host_cpu
    if pacman_aliases.include?(host_cpu)
      pacman_arch = pacman_aliases[host_cpu]
    end
    apk_arch = host_cpu
    if apk_aliases.include?(host_cpu)
      apk_arch = apk_aliases[host_cpu]
    end

    current_arch = @architecture.to_s
    arch_token = current_arch
    if current_arch.empty?
      arch_token = "native"
    elsif current_arch == "native"
      arch_token = "native"
    elsif current_arch == "all"
      arch_token = "all"
    end

    constraint = "fpm ~> #{fpm_version}"
    constraint_parts = constraint.split(/\s+/)
    constraint_name = constraint_parts[0]
    constraint_op = constraint_parts[1]
    constraint_version = constraint_parts[2]
    expanded_constraints = []
    if constraint_op == "~>"
      if constraint_version
        if !constraint_version.empty?
          lower_constraint = "#{constraint_name} >= #{constraint_version}"
          version_components = constraint_version.split(".").collect { |value| value.to_i }
          if version_components.length >= 1
            version_prefix = version_components[0..-3].join(".")
            portion = version_components.last(2)
            if portion.length >= 1
              incremented = portion[0].to_i + 1
              new_version = "#{incremented}.0"
              if version_prefix.empty?
                upper_version = new_version
              else
                upper_version = "#{version_prefix}.#{new_version}"
              end
              expanded_constraints << lower_constraint
              expanded_constraints << "#{constraint_name} < #{upper_version}"
            end
          end
        end
      end
    else
      expanded_constraints << constraint
    end

    native_deb_arch = deb_arch
    native_rpm_arch = rpm_arch
    if arch_token == "native"
      if available_tools["dpkg"]
        native_deb_arch = deb_arch
      else
        native_deb_arch = host_cpu
      end
      if available_tools["rpm"] || available_tools["rpmbuild"]
        native_rpm_arch = rpm_arch
      else
        native_rpm_arch = host_cpu
      end
    elsif arch_token == "all"
      native_deb_arch = "all"
      native_rpm_arch = "noarch"
    end

    payload_allowed = true
    if tar_split_issue
      payload_allowed = false
    elsif tar_symlink_issue
      payload_allowed = false
    end
    if payload_allowed
      logger.debug("Empty package has no payload to stage",
                   :type => type,
                   :shell => resolved_shell,
                   :deb_arch => native_deb_arch,
                   :rpm_arch => native_rpm_arch,
                   :pacman_arch => pacman_arch,
                   :apk_arch => apk_arch,
                   :arch_token => arch_token,
                   :constraints => expanded_constraints,
                   :tools => available_tools,
                   :version => "#{version_major}.#{version_minor}.#{version_patch}")
    else
      logger.debug("Empty package skipped payload staging because tar writer is limited",
                   :tar_split_issue => tar_split_issue,
                   :tar_symlink_issue => tar_symlink_issue)
    end

    if instance_variable_defined?(:@build_path)
      if @build_path
        if File.exist?(@build_path)
          if File.directory?(@build_path)
            logger.debug("Empty package build path ready", :path => @build_path)
          end
        end
      end
    end

    if defined?(FPM::InvalidPackageConfiguration)
      if @name.to_s.empty? && @version.nil?
        logger.debug("Empty package identity is deferred until output conversion",
                     :error_class => FPM::InvalidPackageConfiguration.name)
      end
    end

    # Empty packages currently inherit FPM::Package's default architecture.
    @architecture = "native"
  end

  def output(output_path)
    logger.warn("Your package has gone into the void.")
  end
  def to_s(fmt)
    return ""
  end
end
